description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractUserRole that provides a base implementation for user role management within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving accessible entities and permissions, incorporating traits for user and service handling, and managing role-specific behaviors. The class serves as a foundational component for more specific user role classes in the authorization module.

classes.name: AbstractUserRole
classes.description: An abstract class representing a user's role within the authorization framework, providing methods for permission checks and entity access management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the user role with a role name and a role manager.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Deprecated method intended to retrieve entities accessible to the role based on entity type and operation, throwing an exception if called.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving accessible properties of an entity, currently not implemented.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Returns an array of entity IDs that are accessible for a given entity type, considering required permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to return IDs of accessible entities.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns a list of employees associated with this role; default implementation returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjects
methods.description: Deprecated method for obtaining accessible projects; default returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancies
methods.description: Deprecated method for obtaining accessible vacancies; default returns an empty array.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the required permissions are available for the current user role.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch items accessible based on required permissions; default is an empty list.
